QUARANTINE REQUIRED FOR POSITIVE
PERSONS
If your on-arrival COVID-19 test returns a positive result,
you will be required to self-quarantine for 10 days. After
10 days, you are allowed to leave quarantine and you are
not required to be tested again for release.
This applies to all persons (vaccinated and
unvaccinated)

MONTSERRAT TRAVEL PROTOCOLS
General Travel Guidelines
You do not need a negative COVID-19 test prior to
travelling to Montserrat. However, please check
the requirements for the ports/islands that you
will travel through to get to Montserrat.
You do not have to pay for the COVID-19 Test
which will be conducted on arrival on Montserrat.
If you require a COVID-19 Test when
leaving/departing Montserrat, you will have to pay
this cost. Please see the COVID-19 Test Fees on
page 3.
A child under the age of 18 years who enters
Montserrat will be treated like the adult who
accompanied the child to Montserrat.
A child two years and under is not required to
take a COVID-19 test.
You do not need to register to travel to Montserrat.

COVID-19 TEST FEE EXEMPTIONS
The following persons do not have to pay for a COVID-19
Test:
1. A person who enters Montserrat by air or sea;
2. A person who is required to leave Montserrat on official
Government business, once the person intends to return to
Montserrat immediately after the completion of official
Government business;
3. A person undertaking a course of study at an
educational institution outside of Montserrat;
4. A person who is likely to be infected with COVID-19, as
determined by a Health Officer
5. A person who is referred overseas for medical
treatment;
6. A person under 18 years;
7. An official from an international or regional partner of
the Government of Montserrat, who intends to visit
Montserrat for official business;
8. A person who is over 70 years of age and is residing on
Montserrat, and
9. A pilot who navigates a flight into Montserrat on a
habitual basis.
Public Health (COVID-19 Suppression) (No.4) Order, (S.R.O 29 of 2022) and the
